[[Tormented Land]]s are large [[creature]]s made of stone. They are common near the [[Ancestor Tree]] in [[Turai's Procession]].

==Locations== 
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|Turai's Procession}} (only if [[Troubled Lands]] has not been completed)

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Heavy Blow}}
*{{skill icon|Irresistible Blow}}
*{{skill icon|Staggering Blow}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Granite Slab]]
*[[Lump of Charcoal]]
*[[Ruby]]
*[[Sapphire]]
<!-- Tormented Land hasn't been observed dropping a [[Sentient Lodestone]]. Post a screenshot on [[Talk:Sentient Lodestone]] if you encounter one of them dropping a Lodestone. -->

== Notes ==
* After dying, they will continue to re[[spawn]] approximately every two minutes until completion of the associated quest. 
** Respawned Tormented Lands will not [[drop]] items.
** You do not have to kill the respawned Lands to complete the quest.
* To [[Vanquisher|vanquish]] the area before completing the quest, all 10 of the Lands must be killed at least once, causing [[Earthen Abomination]] to spawn, which must also be killed. This is effectively the same as doing the quest.
